title: Percept DK
description: Azure Percept DK on Ubuntu: board, containers, Myriad X and inference (percept-kit).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Time since the board booted.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: All four Cortex-A53 cores, averaged over 1 minute.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: 1 − MemAvailable / MemTotal. The board has no swap.

panels.title: Disk /
panels.description: Ubuntu's root filesystem on eMMC p5; Docker images and volumes live here too.

panels.title: SoC temp
panels.description: i.MX8MQ thermal zone. The kernel throttles at 80 °C (passive trip point) and shuts down at 90 °C.

panels.title: Myriad X temp
panels.description: Hottest of the Myriad X's four on-die sensors, read by the Eye.

panels.title: Inferences
panels.description: Inference results per second from the Eye's model, over 1 minute.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Docker containers running.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of all four cores, stacked.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Wi-Fi and Ethernet ports that are up; sent traffic is drawn below the axis.

panels.title: CPU by container
panels.description: 100% = one full core; the board has four.

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Working set: what the kernel can't reclaim without swapping.

panels.title: Network by container
panels.description: Received plus sent. node-exporter is left out: it uses the host's network.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Running containers, as cAdvisor sees them every 15 s.

panels.title: Myriad X temperatures
panels.description: The Myriad X's on-die sensors: CPU subsystem (css), media subsystem (mss), SHAVE vector-processor array (upa) and DDR subsystem (dss).

panels.title: Inferences per second
panels.description: Results from the Eye's model, one per inference.

panels.title: Objects in view
panels.description: Objects in the latest inference, by label.

panels.title: Detections per minute
panels.description: Every object in every inference, by label.

panels.title: Myriad X memory in use
panels.description: By pool: main (the DDR pool for frames and networks), leonos_heap and leonrt_heap (the two LEON cores' heaps).

panels.title: USB link
panels.description: 5 Gbit/s is USB 3 SuperSpeed.

panels.title: Eye running for
panels.description: Since the Eye's inference app started.

panels.title: Since last inference
panels.description: Age of the latest result when Prometheus last scraped the Eye (every 15 s). Over a few seconds means the model has stalled.

panels.title: Main pool in use
panels.description: Myriad X DDR in use: frames, the network and its buffers.
